# Vendored libraries

These are served from the app itself (not a CDN) so LoreOS works offline and does not depend on a third party being up.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lz-string.min.js` | [lz-string](https://github.com/pieroxy/lz-string) | 1.5.0 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/) | 3.10.1 | MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later |

Both are unmodified copies of the official npm release files. The licence notice for JSZip is kept in the header of the file.
